rationale: Ground truth has no substantive concerns (just LGTM approvals), so both trivially achieve full recall. X's findings are well-grounded and concrete — notably catching that examples/online_serving/minicpmo/README.md:59 still documents the buggy nested extra_body form this PR fixes elsewhere, a genuine, actionable inconsistency the human reviewers missed. Y's verification is tight and correctly lands on APPROVE matching the real outcome, but its lone comment is hedgy ('worth a sanity check... but if you observed silent WAV directly, keep the current wording') rather than a concrete ask. X edges out on actionability and finding real value beyond the diff, at a small cost to precision from more speculative suggestions (e.g., recommending new unit tests for a docs-only PR).
